note: Sources for scripts/weekly_top5.py. Official feeds and APIs only; no scraping. 'checked' says how each address was confirmed. The weekly workflow log reports whether each one answered.

gdelt.name: GDELT Project DOC 2.0 API
gdelt.credit: News discovery by the GDELT Project (gdeltproject.org). GDELT data is free and open; NETRA cites it as the discovery source.
gdelt.ai_query: ("artificial intelligence" OR deepfake OR deepfakes OR "AI-generated" OR chatbot OR "voice clone" OR "voice cloning" OR "generative AI" OR ChatGPT OR "AI tool" OR "AI app") sourcecountry:IN sourcelang:english
gdelt.cyber_query: (ransomware OR "data breach" OR "cyber attack" OR cyberattack OR phishing OR "CERT-In" OR hacked OR malware OR "data leak") sourcecountry:IN sourcelang:english
gdelt.checked: First workflow run on 2026-10-25 reached the API but got HTTP 429 (too many requests) from the shared GitHub runner, so the script now waits and retries (20, 45, 90 seconds) as GDELT's rate limit asks.

feeds.name: Press Information Bureau: press releases (RSS, as listed)
feeds.checked: Exact address listed on PIB's own RSS page (pib.gov.in/ViewRss.aspx). That page is in Hindi, so the language of this feed is to confirm on the first workflow run. First workflow run on 2026-10-25: HTTP 403 (forbidden) from GitHub's servers. Switched off: NETRA does not work around a site that refuses automated access. PIB releases can still be added by hand.

feeds.name: Press Information Bureau: press releases (RSS, Lang=1)
feeds.checked: Same feed with Lang=1, tried in case it is the English edition. Not confirmed; if it fails or repeats the other feed, the run report says so and it can be switched off. First workflow run on 2026-10-25: HTTP 403 (forbidden) from GitHub's servers. Switched off: NETRA does not work around a site that refuses automated access. PIB releases can still be added by hand.

feeds.name: CERT-In advisories
feeds.checked: No official CERT-In RSS or API address could be confirmed. Left off until the owner confirms one; NETRA does not scrape the CERT-In site.

feeds.name: METR publications (RSS)
feeds.checked: Address from a feed directory listing, not from METR itself. To confirm on the first workflow run. Titles and links only (cite and summarise).

atlas.name: MITRE ATLAS case studies
atlas.checked: Public GitHub repository mitre-atlas/atlas-data, read on 2026-10-25: ATLAS-latest.yaml points to ATLAS-2026.09.yaml; case studies carry created-date.
